operations_summary: Drilled from 2780 m to 2910 m MD into Hugin reservoir sand. At 2890 m MD, encountered partial mud loss of 25 m3/hr. Reduced pump rate, spotted 10 m3 CaCO3 LCM pill. Losses cured. Reached planned TD for section at 2910 m MD (84.5 deg inc).
remarks: Excellent reservoir quality logged: porosity 22-26%, resistivity 120 ohm-m.
